🎯 Initial ODIN Project: Complete ML-Powered K8s Monitoring Platform

ODIN (Omnipresent Diagnostics and Intelligence Network) - Production-ready
Kubernetes monitoring stack with advanced ML anomaly detection for Ubuntu 22.04
systems with NVIDIA RTX GPUs.

## 🚀 Core Features
- **4-Layer ML Anomaly Detection**: GPU, Container, Process, and Disk monitoring
- **15+ Grafana Dashboards**: Real-time visualization and health matrices
- **25+ Alert Rules**: Thermal protection and resource monitoring
- **Production Health Checks**: `/health`, `/healthz`, `/ready` endpoints
- **UML Architecture Diagrams**: Complete deployment and networking views

## 📊 Monitoring Stack
- **Prometheus**: Metrics collection with 90-day retention
- **Grafana**: Visualization with email alerting (Gmail SMTP)
- **Loki**: Log aggregation with real-time streaming
- **AlertManager**: Alert routing and notification
- **Node/Power/Process Exporters**: System and GPU metrics
- **cAdvisor**: Container metrics with cgroups v2 support

## 🤖 ML Anomaly Detection Platform
- **GPU Anomaly Detector** (Port 9405): Thermal and power analysis
- **K8s Pod Anomaly Detector** (Port 9406): Container lifecycle monitoring
- **Process Anomaly Detector** (Port 9407): Security threat detection
- **Disk Anomaly Detector** (Port 9408): Space forecasting and I/O monitoring

## 🔧 Infrastructure
- **K3s Kubernetes**: Single-node cluster with production patterns
- **NVIDIA GPU Support**: RTX 4080 monitoring with device plugin
- **Persistent Storage**: PVCs for data retention across restarts
- **Service Discovery**: Full Kubernetes DNS resolution

## 📈 Current Status: ✅ OPERATIONAL
- 4-layer ML anomaly detection with Isolation Forest + Statistical algorithms
- Real-time anomaly scoring with adaptive baseline learning
- Comprehensive dashboard suite with health matrices and thermal monitoring
- Email alerting for persistent issues (>15 minutes)
- Dashboard backup/restore system with automated procedures
